items.claim: Jeremiah Wells is a black belt in jiu-jitsu.
items.quote: Wells is a black belt in jiu-jitsu.

items.claim: Chanel Dyer is younger, bigger, faster, and more dangerous than Elise Reed.
items.quote: Dyer is younger. Dyer's bigger. Dyer's faster. Dyer's more dangerous.

items.claim: All of Elise Reed's losses inside the UFC are finishes.
items.quote: Elise Reed's five losses inside the UFC all finishes.

items.claim: Chanel Dyer has a height and reach advantage over Elise Reed.
items.quote: She's three inches taller at 5'6 to 5 foot three. Got a 2-in reach advantage.

items.claim: Wes Schultz defeated Jackson McVey by submission in 41 seconds when they fought as amateurs.
items.quote: Wes Schultz won by sub in 41 seconds. I couldn't find the fight though.

items.claim: Wes Schultz has a dangerous guillotine submission threat even when losing grappling exchanges.
items.quote: Wes Schultz is a weird one because his submission game is [ __ ] good. He might be down big, but that Gilly threat is there.
